<?php
$receiver = new Fiber(static function () {
    echo Fiber::suspend('S'), '|';
    Fiber::suspend('T');
    return 13;
});
echo $receiver->start(), '|';
$callback = $receiver->resume(...);
$child = new Fiber($callback);
unset($callback);
echo (int)($child->start(value: 'R') === null), '|', $child->getReturn(), '|';
echo (int)$receiver->isSuspended(), '|';
$receiver->resume();
echo $receiver->getReturn();

<?php
$weakClosure = null;
$weakReceiver = null;
class BoundCoreArgument341 {
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakClosure, $weakReceiver;
        echo 'D', (int)($weakClosure->get() !== null), (int)($weakReceiver->get() !== null), '|';
    }
}
$receiver = new Fiber(static function () {
    try { Fiber::suspend(); echo 'B|'; Fiber::suspend(); }
    finally { echo 'F|'; }
});
$receiver->start();
$callback = $receiver->resume(...);
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($callback);
$weakReceiver = WeakReference::create($receiver);
$child = new Fiber($callback);
unset($callback, $receiver);
$child->start(new BoundCoreArgument341());
echo (int)($weakClosure->get() === null), (int)($weakReceiver->get() === null);

<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () { return 23; });
$target->start();
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$capture = $target->getReturn(...);
$runner = new Fiber($capture);
unset($capture, $target);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo (int)($runner->start() === null), '|', $runner->getReturn(), '|';
echo (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () {
    try { Fiber::suspend(); }
    finally { echo 'F|'; return 59; }
});
$target->start();
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$runner = new Fiber($target->isSuspended(...));
unset($target);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$runner->start();
echo (int)$runner->getReturn(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
class CoreArgument341 {
    function __destruct() { echo 'D', (int)(Fiber::getCurrent() === $GLOBALS['runner']), '|'; }
}
$target = new Fiber(static function () {
    Fiber::suspend();
    echo 'T|';
    Fiber::suspend('R');
    return 19;
});
$target->start();
$runner = new Fiber($target->resume(...));
echo (int)($runner->start(new CoreArgument341()) === null), '|', $runner->getReturn(), '|';
$target->resume();
echo $target->getReturn();

<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () {
    try { Fiber::suspend(); }
    catch (Exception $error) { echo 'C', $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
    return 37;
});
$target->start();
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$get = $target->getReturn(...);
$runner = new Fiber($target->throw(...));
unset($target);
$runner->start(exception: new Exception('X'));
echo $runner->getReturn() === null ? 'N|' : 'V|';
echo $get(), '|';
unset($get);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () { Fiber::suspend(); throw new RuntimeException('body'); });
$target->start();
$weak = WeakReference::create($target);
$runner = new Fiber($target->resume(...));
unset($target);
try { $runner->start(); }
catch (RuntimeException $error) {
    foreach ($error->getTrace() as $row) {
        if ($row['function'] === 'resume' || $row['function'] === 'start') {
            echo $row['function'], $row['type'], (int)isset($row['file']), (int)isset($row['line']), '|';
        }
    }
}
echo (int)$runner->isTerminated(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () { return 41; });
$target->start();
$runner = new Fiber($target->getReturn(...));
try { $runner->start(unexpected: 1); }
catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), '|';
    foreach ($error->getTrace() as $row) {
        echo $row['function'], isset($row['type']) ? $row['type'] : '', '|';
    }
}
echo (int)$runner->isTerminated(), '|', $target->getReturn();

<?php
$target = new Fiber(static function () {
    global $target, $runner, $parent;
    Fiber::suspend();
    echo 'C', (int)(Fiber::getCurrent() === $target), (int)$runner->isRunning(), (int)$parent->isRunning(), '|';
    Fiber::suspend('R');
    return 17;
});
$target->start();
$runner = new Fiber($target->resume(...));
$parent = new Fiber(static function () use ($runner) {
    echo 'P|';
    $runner->start('argument');
    echo $runner->getReturn(), '|', (int)(Fiber::getCurrent() === $GLOBALS['parent']), '|';
    return 31;
});
$parent->start();
echo $parent->getReturn(), '|';
$target->resume();
echo $target->getReturn();

<?php
$f = new Fiber(static function () {});
$capture = $f->isStarted(...);
echo 'P|';
$child = new Fiber($capture);
echo (int)$child->start();

<?php
class BoundCoreIdle341 {
    public $self;
    function __construct() { $this->self = $this; }
    function __destruct() {
        $GLOBALS['worker'] = Fiber::getCurrent();
        echo 'D|';
    }
}
$request = new Fiber(static function () {
    $cycle = new BoundCoreIdle341();
    unset($cycle);
    echo gc_collect_cycles(), '|';
});
$request->start();
unset($request);
$resume = new Fiber($worker->resume(...));
$throw = new Fiber($worker->throw(...));
$suspended = new Fiber($worker->isSuspended(...));
unset($worker);
echo (int)($resume->start(value: 123) === null), '|';
try { $throw->start(exception: new Exception('idle')); }
catch (Exception $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
unset($error);
$suspended->start();
echo (int)$suspended->getReturn(), '|';
unset($resume, $throw, $suspended);
echo 'END';
